title: Partial encryption state on AEAD failure
close_reason: Already fixed. The concern about partial encryption state is mitigated by: (1) SecretVec implements ZeroizeOnDrop - any partial data is zeroized when dropped on error, (2) session is poison()ed on error preventing reuse, (3) ciphertext_3 is a local variable not stored in session state. Security audit commit 7434512 specifically fixed 'Replace empty ZeroizeOnDrop impls with proper Drop calling zeroize()' which addresses this concern.
